property_summary: For any callee address that properly accepts plain calls (i.e., its fallback/receive does not revert), C.sendMoney succeeds (call returns/does not revert) when invoked with value <= contract balance; the mutant inverts the require so successful external calls cause a revert, breaking this rule for such callees and amounts.
change_summary: Invert the require condition so the call must fail (require !success), causing successful calls to revert and changing observed behavior of sendMoney.
